description: This file defines message classes used in a distributed testing framework, specifically ServerMessage and AckMessage, including their properties, constructors, and a static factory method.

classes.name: ServerMessage
classes.description: Represents a server message with a unique ID, and flags indicating if the message is for a graceful shutdown or restart.

classes.name: AckMessage
classes.description: Represents an acknowledgment message with a message ID and server name, including a static method to create such messages.

methods.name: ServerMessage
methods.description: Constructor initializing a server message with flags for graceful shutdown and restart, generating a new message ID.

methods.name: AckMessage
methods.description: Constructor initializing an acknowledgment message with a specific message ID and server name.

methods.name: CreateAckMessage
methods.description: Static factory method to create an AckMessage from a ServerMessage and server name.
